summary: Visium Technologies filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its incubation arrangement with ConnexUS AI, including a proposed 100% equity acquisition under an LOI and a related services SOW. The Board terminated the agreements on June 8, 2026, after determining the incubation failed to achieve objectives. All ATHENA IP remains with ConnexUS; no ownership passed. The parties signed a mutual release extinguishing obligations, with only confidentiality and IP confirmation surviving. What to watch: whether Visium will pursue another AI acquisition or focus on its core RAG/agentic initiatives.
